work_item.title: Independent context manifest producer proof

scope.description: Implement a separate-language producer from the published 0.2 context contract, validate its output with the TypeScript consumer, and document provenance and limitations.

acceptance_criteria: Producer does not call the TypeScript capture implementation
Ordered repeated context and a summary transformation pass the public validator
A generated report preserves the fixture's exact request cost

outcome.summary: Accepted after the independent producer crossed the public context and report seams; usage and cost coverage remain partial because provider billing and hidden calls are unavailable.

estimates.rationale: A declared local three-point anchor for one producer, one consumer integration and one provenance record. This scale is uncalibrated; the estimate is collected before this bounded implementation begins, not before the surrounding v0.2 project.
